title: RunEvent — one JSON object per events.jsonl line
description: Shape is normative here; semantics (seq authority, hash-chain construction, torn-line handling) live in ../events.md. Per-line schema: this validates ONE parsed record, not the file — a file is a sequence of these separated by newlines. schema/prev pairing (prev required iff schema==2, forbidden iff schema==1) and cross-line invariants (seq monotonicity, chain hashing) are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and are restated as conformance rules on the events page, enforced by `faff events validate`.

seq.description: authoritative monotonic order; ts is best-effort only

prev.description: required iff schema==2, forbidden iff schema==1 — SHA-256 of the previous physical line's raw bytes (genesis: SHA-256 of this record's own run_id)

issue.description: required iff type is issue-scoped (issue-admitted, prep-start, prep-done, build-start, issue-outcome, park, corrective-authored, corrective-consumed, containment-check, self-intake-check)

data.description: free-form; typed optional tags include tokens/tokens_source, effort, gate/rework_turns, outcome (required for issue-outcome, one of the ledger_outcomes enum), ledger_sha256 (required Hex64 for type ledger-write)
